dims.justification: Only the broad field of quantum computing is named, with no concrete problems, methods, datasets, or goals stated anywhere in the records: ev25 notes IBM 'has deployed over 90 quantum systems' (a capability statement, not a research direction) and ev5 is a high-uncertainty implication that quantum computing 'has the potential to create over $500B in value at tech maturity'. The opportunity's area field is blank, so this matches the anchor for a broad field named only, with no specific problems or goals.

The records document multiple sustained industry engagements and explicit standing commitments to industry partners: IBM 'will be the preferred services and customer financing provider to Lenovo' (ev33), the Red Hat acquisition was approved by both boards and structured as a distinct unit (ev46, ev45) with expected free-cash-flow and gross-margin accretion within 12 months (ev43), and IBM reported '$35 Billion in Signings YTD' (ev78). This satisfies the anchor for multiple or sustained industry engagements and explicit standing commitments to industry partners.

The evidence shows ongoing, case-by-case engagement with new counterparties — '$35 Billion in Signings YTD' (ev78) and a large addressable market for outside service providers (ev47) — with no stated preference for or restriction against particular partner types. Nothing in the records shows IBM actively welcoming small or unfunded partners or explicitly soliciting new collaborations with described working modes, so the neutral, case-by-case anchor fits best.

No availability or capacity information for a pilot window appears anywhere in the records; the most recent items merely show continuing corporate activity, such as the press release dated July 23, 2025 regarding Q2 2025 financial results (ev24) and the Form 8-K reporting an earliest event dated October 21, 2026 (ev73). This matches the anchor for no availability information present.

Multiple distinct verified filings and disclosures agree on details: Red Hat transaction facts are consistent across ev43, ev45, ev46 and ev49; the $.20 par value recurs across ev14, ev39 and ev54; the 7.125% debentures due 2096 appear in both ev26 and ev60; and the 93.6% shareholder ratification of the independent auditor (ev13) adds external validation. However, all records originate from IBM's own disclosures rather than fully independent third parties, so this reaches the 'two or more sources agree' anchor but not the multiple-current-independent-sources anchor.

All documented external engagement is confined to existing corporate stakeholders and channels — investor earnings calls and webcasts (ev10, ev14, ev65) and wholly-owned affiliates (ev1, ev9) — with no record soliciting or welcoming new partners or describing working modes such as consulting, capstone, or sponsored research. ev115 further indicates Deere has no publicly accessible LinkedIn page, limiting open external visibility. Corporate facts are repeated consistently across many separate Deere filings spanning years — the world-leader positioning appears in ev13, ev57, ev58, ev60 and ev71, and the NYSE 'DE' listing in ev34 and ev41 — but every record is a self-reported company disclosure (SEC filings and press releases) with no independent third-party source corroborating anything relevant to the opportunity, and some records are stale (ev30: debentures that came due in 2022).
